title: Driver seat adjustment and memory behavior
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on driver-seat adjustment range, seat movement and memory-position behavior, with some fragments also touching on seat-heater-related effects and driver-recognition timing.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention the car being enjoyable to drive and a preference for seat-side control placement.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on insufficient seat-control range and the driver's seat failing to return to the prior stored position.

mixed.summary: The mixed review describes door-panel warming near the armrest when the seat heater is on, but cooling again when the heater is switched off.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention seat height, automatic seat movement, recognition timing, passenger-seat control from the driver side, and impact-related seat motion without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: This cluster mixes several related but distinct seat topics, including adjustment range, memory/auto-move behavior, seat-heater effects, and driver-recognition timing.
Many sampled fragments are terse service-style notes or lack enough context to determine sentiment, which limits how specifically the topic can be summarized.
The supplied examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of all G70 seat-related feedback.
